svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Cloud Detective dashboard and AI agent on AWS. 1. Users sign in with Cognito (authorization code with PKCE); there is no self sign-up. 2. API Gateway checks the Cognito token on every /api/* route; the page shell is public. 3. One Lambda serves the dashboard and its JSON API. 4. Ask the detective: the API Lambda invokes the chat agent asynchronously, and the page polls. 5. Only the model call leaves AWS, to an OpenAI-compatible provider; its key is in SSM SecureString. 6. The agent reads AWS under ViewOnlyAccess, and can add findings or mark them resolved. 7. The architecture worker discovers resources and writes the diagram to S3. 8. Run scan invokes the scanner on demand. There is no CloudFront: the account could not create distributions, and API Gateway serves HTTPS. The chat agent and the architecture worker also assume the member accounts' read-only role.
svg.text: AWS Account · where Cloud Detective runs
Users sign in with Cognito (authorization code with PKCE); there is no self sign-up.
API Gateway checks the Cognito token on every /api/* route; the page shell is public.
One Lambda serves the dashboard and its JSON API.
Ask the detective: the API Lambda invokes the chat agent asynchronously, and the page polls.
Only the model call leaves AWS, to an OpenAI-compatible provider; its key is in SSM SecureString.
The agent reads AWS under ViewOnlyAccess, and can add findings or mark them resolved.
The architecture worker discovers resources and writes the diagram to S3.
Run scan invokes the scanner on demand.
Dashed line: API Gateway validating the Cognito token.
There is no CloudFront: the account could not create distributions, and API Gateway serves HTTPS.
The chat agent and the architecture worker also assume the member accounts' read-only role.
